title: Design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of novel 3-oxo-2,3-dihydropyridazine derivatives as interleukin-2-inducible T-cell kinase (ITK) inhibitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47565-47586
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06565H, Paper
Open Access

Sudhakar Tangallapalli, Rambabu Gundla, Kalyani Paidikondala, Soňa Gurská, Naveen Kumar Rampeesa, Sreenivasa Reddy Anugu, Petr Džubák, Marián Hajdúch, Viswanath Das, Naresh Kumar Katari
This study reports the design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of a novel series of 3-oxo-2,3-dihydropyridazine derivatives for selective inhibition of ITK, with potential application in T-cell leukemia treatment.
